about_short_description.short_description: UiPath is a software company that designs and develops robotic process automation and artificial intelligence applications.

product.name: UiPath Platform
product.description: An enterprise automation platform that combines AI agents, robotic process automation, UI and API automation, document processing, orchestration, governance, and analytics.

product.name: UiPath Agentic Automation
product.description: An automation approach and platform capability that coordinates AI agents, robots, people, UI automations, and APIs to execute complex business workflows.

product.name: UiPath Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
product.description: Software robots that automate repetitive, rule-based tasks by interacting with desktop applications, web interfaces, documents, and enterprise systems.

product.name: UiPath Studio
product.description: A development environment for designing, testing, and maintaining robotic process automations, workflows, and integrations.

product.name: UiPath Orchestrator
product.description: A centralized management service for deploying, scheduling, monitoring, securing, and governing software robots and automation processes.

product.name: UiPath Maestro
product.description: A business orchestration product for coordinating AI agents, robots, applications, APIs, and human actions across complex processes.
